MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JANUARY 14, 2020

A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order by
MAYOR SCHMITZ at 6:00 p.m. and the City Council convened into closed session in the
Conference Room at City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman ‘

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present: City Manager Greg Grammer

CLOSED SESSION (TAKEN OUT OF ORDER)

A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Government Code Section 54957
  Title: City Manager (Quarterly Evaluation)

MAYOR SCHMITZ adjourned the Closed Session portion of the meeting at 6:55 p.m.

At 7:03 p.m., MAYOR SCHMITZ called the meeting back to order in open session in the Council
Chamber at City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Students from Palos Verdes Intermediate School, winners of the 2019 Palos Verdes Peninsula
Holiday Parade of Lights Susan Seamans Best School Float Award, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present: City Manager Greg Grammer
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Community Services Supervisor Cynthia Morquecho
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

CEREMONIAL ITEMS

NONE.

CONSENT CALENDAR

  The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of
  the City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown
  by a member prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on
  separately.)

  COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF requested that Item 5B (City Council adjourned minutes of
  December 10, 2019) be removed for individual consideration.

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZUCKERMAN requested that Item 5H (General Plan Advisory
  Committee minutes of December 16, 2019) be removed for individual consideration.

  There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

  COUNCIL MEMBER  MITCHELL  moved,  seconded  by,  COUNCIL  MEMBER
  ZERUNYAN,

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
JANUARY 14, 2020
   THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS A AND C-
  G APPROVE AS RECOMMENDED

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS BY TITLE ONLY

  APPROVED.

C.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF DECEMBER 10, 2019

  APPROVED.

D.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS – DECEMBER 2019 AND JANUARY 2020

  APPROVED WARRANTS 62275 THROUGH 62364 IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $293,902.16 AND SUPPLEMENTAL WARRANTS 120219 THROUGH 120619
  AND 010120 THROUGH 010320 IN THE AMOUNT OF $392,018.29 FOR A
  GRAND TOTAL AMOUNT OF $685,920.45 WITH PROPER AUDIT.

E.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS REPORT – NOVEMBER 2019

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

F.  REVENUE AND EXPENDITURE REPOT – NOVEMBER 2019

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

G.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF DECEMBER 16, 2019

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

REMOVED FOR INDIVIDUAL CONSIDERATION:

B.  CITY COUNCIL ADJOURNED MINUTES OF DECEMBER 10, 2019 – 1) COMMITTEE
  INTERVIEWS AND 2) MARLOMA SEWER WORKSHOP

  COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF SUGGESTED that the minutes be amended to include
  additional information regarding the three options that were presented for consideration.

  COUNCIL MEMBER  MITCHELL  moved,  seconded  by,  COUNCIL  MEMBER
  ZERUNYAN,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE MINUTES WITH A REVISION TO
  THE MARLOMA SEWER WORKSHOP MINUTES TO INCLUDE ADDITIONAL
  INFORMATION REGARDING THE THREE OPTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION.

  There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered,

H.  GENERAL PLAN ADVISORY COMMITTEE MINUTES OF DECEMBER 17, 2019

  MAYOR PRO TEM ZUCKERMAN noted that minutes do not mention the landfill area as
  set aside for open space and recreation. MAYOR SCHMITZ clarified that there was
  considerable discussion around that topic. Discussion ensued concerning open space
  versus recreational space.

  MAYOR SCHMITZ suggested that the minutes be amended to provide more context
  around the open space/recreational space discussion.

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN moved, seconded by, MAYOR PRO TEM
  ZUCKERMAN,

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
JANUARY 14, 2020
   THAT THE CITY COUNCIL RECEIVE AND FILE THE MINUTES WITH
  DIRECTION TO STAFF TO REVISE THE MINUTES TO INCORPORATE MORE
  CONTEXT AROUND THE OPEN SPACE/RECREATIONAL SPACE
  DISCUSSION.

  There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered,

PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

NONE.

NEW BUSINESS

** ADJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION CORPORATION MEETING **

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHEL,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION
  CORPORATION MEETING

There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

A.  REGULAR PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING

  (1) PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ANNUAL REPORT

  Recommendation: That the Rolling Hills Estates Pepper Tree Foundation Board of
  Directors conduct any necessary Foundation business and receive and file this report.

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho provided a staff report (as per the agenda
  material).

  MAYOR SCHMITZ noted that COMMISSIONER POPE has requested that the Van Ingen
  reference in her name be eliminated and asked staff to make that correction in the list of
  board members

  COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER ZUCKERMAN,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL RECEIVE AND FILE THE PEPPERTREE
  FOUNDATION ANNUAL REPORT.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

  (2) PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION LOGO

  Recommendation: That the Rolling Hills Estates Pepper Tree Foundation Board of
  Directors review and approve the newly revised Pepper Tree Foundation logo.

  Assistant City Manager Davis provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

  COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE NEWLY REVISED PEPPERTREE
  FOUNDATION LOGO.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  3
JANUARY 14, 2020
   ABSENT:  None

  (3) PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION SPONSORSHIP PROGRAM

  Recommendation: That the Rolling Hills Estates Pepper Tree Foundation Board of
  Directors adopt the Sponsorship Program as presented to be implemented for 2020 City
  events.

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho provided a staff report (as per the agenda
  material).

  In response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, Community Services Supervisor Morquecho
  stated that the maximum sponsorship level of $7,500 was set so there would not be a
  large increase over previous years’ presenting sponsor category.

  In response to COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL regarding not allowing competing
  businesses in the top tier sponsorship category Ms. Morquecho noted that previously,
  only one presenting sponsor was approached for each event but going forward it would
  likely be on a first come, first served basis.

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN suggested making the sponsorship levels consistent
  across each of the events. Assistant City Manager Davis explained that the levels for
  some events were left consistent with previous donation levels so as not to alienate any
  prior sponsors, but the levels could be adjusted to provide more consistency across all
  events.

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN suggested adding the sponsor logos to the Pepper
  Tree foundation web site when it is created and providing more event tickets (i.e.: 6 or 8)
  to the sponsors. He also suggested looking into other fundraising opportunities through
  wills and trusts.

  Following discussion, the CITY COUNCIL concurred in providing the following direction:

  DIRECT STAFF TO AMEND THE PROGRAM AS DISCUSSED AND RETURN
  TO THE BOARD FOR FINAL APPROVAL.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL ADJOURN THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION
  CORPORATION MEETING AND RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING

There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

** RECONVENE CITY COUNCIL MEETING

OLD BUSINESS

NONE.

CITY ATTORNEY ITEMS

NONE.

CITY COUNCIL/REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS:

COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF reported that she attended the League of California Cities Los
Angeles Division’s January meeting where South Coast Air Quality Management District
Executive Officer Wayne Nastri provided an overview of federal legislation regarding air quality
and California SB 732.

COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHELL provided additional information SB 732, authored by Senator
Ben Allen that would authorize the south coast district board to impose a voter approved

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  4
JANUARY 14, 2020
 transactions and use tax within the boundaries of the south coast district. She shared
background information on the bill and the reasons why SCAQMD is moving forward with the
bill.

MAYOR SCHMITZ reported that she, along with COUNCIL MEMBERS HUFF and ZERUNYAN,
City Manager Grammer and Administrative Analyst Slawson attended the California Contract
Cities Association Legislative Forum in Sacramento January 5-7. She provided a brief overview
of the conference noting that there will be more housing legislation in the coming year.

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN provided information on the status of SB 50 (Wiener) noting
that even if this bill does not move forward, there will be more housing bills coming.

MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS:

  This item provides the opportunity for Members of the City Council to request information on currently
  pending projects and/or issues of public concern, direct that an item be agendized for future
  consideration and/or make announcements of interest to the public.

A.  COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS 2020

  Recommendation: That the City Council review and  discuss  the  proposed
  Council/Committee assignments and approve as presented.

  City Manager Grammer provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

  COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER MITCHEL,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE 2020 COMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS
  AS PRESENTED.

  There being no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

CLOSED SESSION

A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Government Code Section 54957
  Title: City Manager (Quarterly Evaluation)

  NO REPORTABLE ACTION

MAYOR SCHMITZ noted that this will be City Clerk Luce’s last City Council meeting as she is
leaving to take a position in the City of Paramount and thanked her for her outstanding service to
the community.

ADJOURNMENT

At 8:13 p.m. MAYOR SCHMITZ adjourned the City Council meeting in memory of local resident
and philanthropist Ralph Scriba. The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday,
January 28, 2020 at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045
Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Carol Corea  Greg Grammer
Acting City Clerk  City Manager

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  5
JANUARY 14, 2020
